meta.topic: Getting a Little Better Every Day

headline: Incremental improvement compounds—small daily gains accumulate into massive change over time
universal_truth: You don't have to get better all at once; consistent small improvements add up to transformation
fun_facts: 1% improvement daily compounds to 37x improvement in a year
Japanese 'kaizen' philosophy built Toyota's quality dominance through continuous small improvements
British Cycling went from no Olympic golds to dominating through 'aggregation of marginal gains'
discussion_questions: What could you improve by 1% today?
Where would consistent small gains compound most effectively?
What's preventing you from making incremental improvements?

hook.script: One percent better seems insignificant. But 1% better every day compounds to 37 times better in a year. Small improvements accumulate. Transformation doesn't require revolution—just consistent small steps forward.

cliff.script: We often wait for big changes, but incremental improvement is more sustainable and often more powerful. Why?

options.text: Small improvements compound—each gain builds on previous gains; consistent small steps accumulate into massive change while avoiding the overwhelm of attempted transformation
options.response: Yes. Big changes are hard to sustain. Small changes accumulate. The math of compounding makes tiny daily improvements astonishingly powerful over time.

options.text: Small changes are easier to make
options.response: Easier, yes, and sustainability matters—but the compounding math is the key insight...

fact1.title: Compound Effect
fact1.script: Improvement compounds like interest. Yesterday's improvement is today's baseline. Tomorrow's improvement builds on today's. The curve is exponential, not linear.

fact2.title: Sustainability
fact2.script: Dramatic change often collapses—it's too hard to maintain. Small change is sustainable. What you can do consistently beats what you can do spectacularly once.

fact3.title: Daily Question
fact3.script: The incremental improvement question: 'What's one small way I could do this better tomorrow?' Asked daily, answered daily, the results accumulate.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You don't have to get better all at once. Consistent small improvements add up to transformation. Focus on the next 1%.

outro.script: That's Day 289. Tomorrow, we'll explore knowing a lot about something—expertise. Until then, find one thing you could improve by 1%.

growTrack.title: 1% Improvement Hunt - What Can Get Slightly Better?
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify opportunities for small daily improvements
growTrack.activity: Pick one area of your life. What's one small way you could do it 1% better tomorrow? Not a transformation—just a tiny improvement. Apply this question daily for compound effects.
